content: Melvin-Koushki quotes the epilogue of Ibn Turka's R. Anjām, which cites al-Thaʿālibī's report that when Ḥ-M ʿ-S-Q (Q 42:1-2) was revealed the Prophet seemed exhausted, and ʿAlī explained that the verse indicates the community will “treat his exalted family most improperly”.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Anjām, epilogue, MS Majlis 10196 f.159a (per MK fn.153)
